response.answer: For data sharing, document encryption standards, user roles, retention periods, and pseudonymization. Ensure compliance with HIPAA, GDPR, and IRB requirements. Include explicit consent for data access in informed consent forms.

results.title: Q&A: Good clinical practice (GCP) - EMA - European Union
results.content: The purpose of this document is to state the importance of sponsors to include an explicit passage in their informed consent form (ICF) regarding the authorisation for EU inspectors to direct access and review of trial participants’ medical records (including applicable electronic systems) and other personal data in EU/EEA and non-EU/EEA countries. According to the combined reading of sections 5.1.2 and 1.21 of ICH-GCP, the sponsor is responsible, to secure agreement from all involved parties to ensure that regulatory authorities have direct access to all trial related sites, source data/documents, and reports for the purpose of inspection. “*A risk-based approach to assessing suitability of third parties as well as of sponsor-oversight activities should be implemented*.” (ICH E6 [R2] 5.0).To comply with regulatory requirements, the sponsor should establish documented processes (e.g. SOPs) for evaluating service providers and measures to adequately oversee outsourced duties and functions (tasks) related to clinical trials.
